name: Elara Quinn
source:
Daughter of a scientist who theorized about "future vision," a legacy she's carried quietly ever since. [url=/c166727]Protagonist[/url]'s former teacher and long-time secret crush. One day, after finding him unconscious (thanks to [url=/c166728]Professor Dingus[/url]), she recognized the symptoms her father had described. She helped him prepare for and pass the Dawnbringer exam, encouraging him to embrace his strange gift.
